claim: Native E packages can retain an admitted full root, its validity certificate, route history, derived framed state and typed observation equation without seeding an observation result. Equal endpoint readouts need not identify histories. If equal present observations have unequal future observations, no update on the compressed value alone exists.
policy: Only full root values with explicit validity witnesses are seeded. Frame realization and observation are declared functions; history endpoints select them. E indices retain history, state equality and observation equality. Generic safe Cubical proofs do not interpret exact multiradical matrices. Runtime instances use the actual source-sector frame and observation receipts and retain those source pins.
controls: runtime zero and lost-direction states separated by fixed future readout
boundary: Retained observation packages under declared functions, not physical acquisition authority, a native matrix equivalence or local geometric field descent.
stop_condition: Fresh generic native proofs and false-observation hostile plus source-bound runtime instances, or first failed cell.
